title: Record the later half of register 356
body:
## Summary
- Immediately before event 19156, register 356 holds `1/2` when register 359 starts at `1`. The data register contributes `0`.
- Event 11809 copies register 360 at `1`. Event 16016 copies that `1` into register 292, and event 16017 adds `-1/2` times register 292.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The value of register 354 at event 24284 is not traced.
